crossrefs.text: I have seen a wicked, ruthless man flourishing like a well-rooted native tree,
yet he passed away and was no more; though I searched, he could not be found.
Like one waking from a dream, so You, O Lord, awaken and despise their form.
You sweep them away in their sleep; they are like the new grass of the morning—
You said in your heart: “I will ascend to the heavens; I will raise my throne above the stars of God. I will sit on the mount of assembly, in the far reaches of the north.
I will ascend above the tops of the clouds; I will make myself like the Most High.”
The pride of your heart has deceived you, O dwellers in the clefts of the rocks whose habitation is the heights, who say in your heart, ‘Who can bring me down to the ground?’
Though you soar like the eagle and make your nest among the stars, even from there I will bring you down,” declares the LORD.
You will vomit up what little you have eaten and waste your pleasant words.
When Judas, who had betrayed Him, saw that Jesus was condemned, he was filled with remorse and returned the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders.
“I have sinned by betraying innocent blood,” he said. “What is that to us?” they replied. “You bear the responsibility.”
His mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and violence; trouble and malice are under his tongue.
There is a grievous evil I have seen under the sun: wealth hoarded to the harm of its owner,
or wealth lost in a failed venture, so when that man has a son there is nothing to pass on.

When the woman saw that the tree was good for food and pleasing to the eyes, and that it was desirable for obtaining wisdom, she took the fruit and ate it. She also gave some to her husband who was with her, and he ate it.
not one will ever see the land that I swore to give their fathers. None of those who have treated Me with contempt will see it.
This is the wicked manʼs portion from God— the heritage the ruthless receive from the Almighty.
Yet before they had filled their desire, with the food still in their mouths,
Godʼs anger flared against them, and He put to death their strongest and subdued the young men of Israel.
You will place them in a fiery furnace at the time of Your appearing. In His wrath the LORD will engulf them, and the fire will consume them.
Whoever flees the sound of panic will fall into the pit, and whoever climbs from the pit will be caught in the snare. For the windows of heaven are open, and the foundations of the earth are shaken.
It will be like a man who flees from a lion, only to encounter a bear, or who enters his house and rests his hand against the wall, only to be bitten by a snake.
His archers surround me. He pierces my kidneys without mercy and spills my gall on the ground.
Terrors frighten him on every side and harass his every step.
